turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to cut down on caffeine, and I've got a few ideas about how.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could switch my afternoon cup to decaf and keep the morning one normal.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another idea is half caf, mixing regular and decaf beans for every cup.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or swap coffee for green tea, which has less caffeine but still gives a little lift.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd start with the afternoon decaf, it's a small change with a big effect. Half caf is nice if you drink many cups, and green tea is a good fit if you're open to change.
